description: This is a source file defining client-side form behavior for the 'Video' doctype within the ERPNext platform. It handles form refresh, toggling sections based on provider, and adds a custom button to trigger a YouTube video display.

methods.name: refresh
methods.description: Handles form refresh event, toggling YouTube statistics section and adding a 'Watch Video' button.

methods.name: toggle_youtube_statistics_section
methods.description: Toggles visibility of the YouTube tracking section based on the provider and settings.
